about: North Perth is a municipality in Perth County, Ontario, centred on the town of Listowel with surrounding rural wards including Atwood and other farm communities. Agriculture, a compact main street, and light industry shape a classic southwestern Ontario countryside municipality rather than a big city. About 15,000 people live in North Perth.
seoSummary: Perth County municipality centred on Listowel—farm country and a small-town main street, not a city.
